12. Colors play a big role for X football club
X didn't always wear blue and gold. In their first few years (1905–1906), they wore pink, then black-and-white stripes. After a match against a local rival who wore similar colors, they decided to play a game of chance to pick a permanent identity. The founders went to the nearby docks and agreed to adopt the colors of the next ship that sailed into port. It happened to be the Drottning Sophia, a Swedish freighter. Because it was flying the Swedish flag, X famously adopted the blue and yellow.
X’s rivalry with Y (who wear Red and White) is so intense that it affects multi-million dollar corporate deals. When Coca-Cola became a stadium sponsor, the club refused to let them display their traditional red-and-white logo. They are one of the few places in the world where the brand is forced to abandon its signature red.
